permit.applies: The engaging company or organisation sponsors (a covering letter explaining the reason and duration), applied for online through the Immigration Portal; an individual may also apply in their own capacity.
permit.first: A copy of the contract and the company's covering letter.
permit.eligibility: This is a temporary pass that allows one to work on short contract, obtain medical treatment, tourism and exploring business opportunities etc.

sources.title: Directorate of Citizenship and Immigration Control (NCIC), Special Pass
sources.said: This is a temporary pass that allows one to work on short contract, obtain medical treatment, tourism and exploring business opportunities etc. … Covering letter from the company explaining reason for special pass and duration of stay … Copy of Contract … USD 400 for 3 months

sources.title: Directorate of Citizenship and Immigration Control (NCIC), Work Permit
sources.said: This permit allows the applicant to live and work in Uganda. This permit is always sponsored by an organization or company which must have a mandatory organization code.

blockers.sought: How long the Directorate takes to decide a Special Pass

tried.institution: immigration.go.ug Special Pass, Work Permit and Fees pages read: no decision time, union step, pay rule or exemption, and no statement whether the pass is extended. Retry 2026-11-01: immigration.go.ug's FAQs (general page and the Immigration Control FAQs, pages 1-4, saved as UG-faqs*.html) read: they cover online payment (3% surcharge), extension and appeal (30 days after a rejection) but give no decision time, union step, pay rule or exemption for a Special Pass.
tried.official-register: The Uganda Citizenship and Immigration Control (Fees) Regulations 2021 PDF on immigration.go.ug was saved (UG-fees2021.pdf) but is a scanned image with no text layer, and no OCR is available here. Retry 2026-11-01: The Fees Regulations 2021 scan (UG-fees2021.pdf) holds fees only, so it wasn't transcribed for these fields.
